es: Presentar una propuesta completa para un evento del barrio (objetivo, beneficio, plan con fechas y petición) y responder a objeciones con un plan.

teaching.en: Admittedly, the budget is tight, but we have a fallback plan that we can put into action within a week if the grant is refused.
teaching.es: Es cierto que el presupuesto es ajustado, pero tenemos un plan alternativo que podemos poner en marcha en una semana si se rechaza la subvención.
teaching.explanationEs: Admittedly reconoce un punto débil antes de contrarrestarlo; fallback = plan de reserva.
segments: Admittedly, the budget is tight, but we have a fallback plan that we
can put into action within a week if the grant is refused.
teaching.audioText: Admittedly, the budget is tight, but we have a fallback plan that we can put into action within a week if the grant is refused.

teaching.en: I understand your concern about noise, and I would like to address it directly before we move on to the schedule.
teaching.es: Entiendo tu preocupación por el ruido y quisiera abordarla directamente antes de pasar al calendario.
teaching.explanationEs: Concern = preocupación; address a concern = tratarla de frente, sin esquivarla.
segments: I understand your concern about noise, and I would like to
address it directly before we move on to the schedule.
teaching.audioText: I understand your concern about noise, and I would like to address it directly before we move on to the schedule.

teaching.en: That is a fair objection, but the festival will end at ten, so the noise will stop early enough to placate every resident.
teaching.es: Es una objeción razonable, pero el festival terminará a las diez, así que el ruido cesará lo bastante pronto para apaciguar a cada vecino.
teaching.explanationEs: Fair objection reconoce la duda; la respuesta concreta va después de but.
segments: That is a fair objection, but the festival will end at ten,
so the noise will stop early enough to placate every resident.
teaching.audioText: That is a fair objection, but the festival will end at ten, so the noise will stop early enough to placate every resident.

teaching.en: To reassure every resident and allay their fears about litter, we will have cleaned the square by midnight and will mitigate the noise with a strict closing time.
teaching.es: Para tranquilizar a cada vecino y calmar sus temores por la basura, habremos limpiado la plaza antes de medianoche y reduciremos el ruido con un horario de cierre estricto.
teaching.explanationEs: Reassure + persona (sin to); allay fears y mitigate a risk: suavizar un temor o un riesgo.
segments: To reassure every resident and allay their fears about litter, we will have cleaned
the square by midnight and will mitigate the noise with a strict closing time.
teaching.audioText: To reassure every resident and allay their fears about litter, we will have cleaned the square by midnight and will mitigate the noise with a strict closing time.

teaching.en: If some members push back, we will try to win over the ones who are unsure, and we will forestall their questions by publishing the answers before the council meets to approve the plan.
teaching.es: Si algunos miembros se oponen, intentaremos ganarnos a los que dudan y nos adelantaremos a sus preguntas publicando las respuestas antes de que el consejo se reúna para aprobar el plan.
teaching.explanationEs: Push back = oponerse con firmeza; win over = convencer a quien dudaba; forestall = adelantarse a una pregunta.
segments: If some members push back, we will try to win over the ones who are unsure, and
we will forestall their questions by publishing the answers before the council meets to approve the plan.
teaching.audioText: If some members push back, we will try to win over the ones who are unsure, and we will forestall their questions by publishing the answers before the council meets to approve the plan.

teaching.en: A complete proposal states its objective, recommends a plan with dates, makes a clear request and answers every objection.
teaching.es: Una propuesta completa enuncia su objetivo, recomienda un plan con fechas, hace una petición clara y responde a cada objeción.
teaching.explanationEs: Resumen de la tarea final: objetivo, plan con fechas, petición y respuesta a objeciones.
segments: A complete proposal states its objective, recommends a plan with
dates, makes a clear request and answers every objection.
teaching.audioText: A complete proposal states its objective, recommends a plan with dates, makes a clear request and answers every objection.

prompt.es: Elige la respuesta que atiende mejor la preocupación de este vecino.

choices.text: Admittedly, it may be noisy in the evening, but the swap will end at five.
That is a fair objection: we will have cleaned the square by six.
We request a grant of 500 dollars for tables, posters and some extra chairs.

feedback.es: El vecino teme la basura: solo la respuesta sobre la limpieza reconoce la objeción y da un hecho concreto; hablar del ruido o pedir dinero no la atiende.

hint.es: Fíjate en qué teme exactamente el vecino: no es el ruido ni el dinero.

origin.text: Resident: «I like the idea of a winter clothes swap, but I am worried that nobody will clean the square afterwards, and last year the street was covered in litter.»

prompt.es: Completa: «Para calmar sus temores, la música se detendrá a las diez.»

feedback.es: Allay fears es la colocación para calmar o disipar temores.

hint.es: Es el verbo formal que acompaña a «fears» o «concerns».

origin.text: Some neighbours dislike the noise at night. To ___ their fears, we will stop the music at ten o'clock.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Es una objeción razonable, pero tenemos un plan alternativo.»

answer.text: That is a fair objection but we have a fallback plan

feedback.es: Se reconoce la objeción con That is a fair objection y se responde tras but con un plan de reserva.

hint.es: Primero reconoces la duda y después, tras but, ofreces el plan.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué se compromete a hacer el equipo para tranquilizar a los vecinos.

choices.text: To move the swap to a quieter street.
To ask the council for extra guards.
To finish early and leave the square clean.

feedback.es: Sara promete terminar a las cinco y dejar todo limpio a las seis; no habla de cambiar de calle ni de pedir guardias.

origin.audio: Thank you for coming tonight. Let me begin with our objective: to hold a winter clothes swap in the square on 14 November. The main benefit is tangible, because families will save money and fewer clothes will be thrown away. We recommend that the council approve the square for one afternoon, and we request a grant of five hundred dollars. I know some of you are worried about noise and litter. Admittedly, those are fair objections, so the swap will finish at five, and we will have cleaned everything by six.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta reconoce la objeción de la concejala y propone una solución?

choices.text: Admittedly, Saturday is busy, but the match ends at four and we will start at five.
Saturday is the only possible day for us, so the date will not change for anyone this year.
Football is not our concern at all, and the traffic will surely be somebody else's problem to solve.

feedback.es: Solo la respuesta que admite el problema y lo resuelve con otra hora atiende la objeción; las demás la ignoran o la descartan.

origin.text: Member: «I like the idea, but Saturday afternoon is when the football match is on, and the whole area will be full of cars. Why not choose a Sunday?»

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con la función que cumple al responder a una objeción.

feedback.es: Responder bien a una objeción combina reconocerla, mostrar que se ha entendido y ofrecer una alternativa o un hecho.

prompt.es: Escucha la noticia. ¿Cómo reacciona Leo ante la objeción de la concejala?

choices.text: He denies that the risk exists and simply repeats his original request.
He accepts the risk and answers it with a concrete plan.
He cancels the proposal until the wooden boxes become much cheaper.

feedback.es: Leo admite que el riesgo es real y responde con revisiones semanales y un plan alternativo: no lo niega ni retira la propuesta.

origin.audio: Leo's proposal for a street library has reached the council. He recommends that three wooden boxes be placed near the bus stop, and he requests a grant of 300 dollars. One member pushed back: she fears the boxes will bring litter and that nobody will look after them. Leo did not argue. He agreed that the risk was real, offered a weekly check by two volunteers, and promised a fallback: if the boxes were damaged, they would be moved inside the school.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez. ¿Qué da a entender Leo al prometer un plan alternativo?

choices.text: That he doubts that the council will ever approve the grant in time.
That the boxes will be moved inside the school at the end of this week.
That he has thought about what to do if the idea fails.

feedback.es: Un plan B prometido de antemano muestra que Leo ha previsto el fallo; el traslado al colegio es solo una posibilidad, no algo decidido.

origin.audio: Leo's proposal for a street library has reached the council. He recommends that three wooden boxes be placed near the bus stop, and he requests a grant of 300 dollars. One member pushed back: she fears the boxes will bring litter and that nobody will look after them. Leo did not argue. He agreed that the risk was real, offered a weekly check by two volunteers, and promised a fallback: if the boxes were damaged, they would be moved inside the school.

prompt.es: Completa: «Podemos mitigar el riesgo de basura con dos voluntarios que revisen la calle.»

feedback.es: Mitigate the risk significa reducir su efecto; es la colocación formal para riesgos.

origin.text: The council wants proof that the plan will really work. We can ___ the risk of litter by asking two volunteers to check the street every evening.

prompt.es: Escribe una propuesta para un trueque de ropa de invierno y responde a una objeción.

answer.text: The objective of this proposal is to organise a winter clothes swap in the square on 14 November. The most tangible benefit is that families will save money and throw away fewer clothes. We recommend that the council approve the square for one afternoon, and we request a grant of 500 dollars for tables and posters. By 1 November we will have printed the posters, and within two weeks we will be advertising the swap in schools and shops. Admittedly, some residents may worry about noise and litter. That is a fair objection, but the swap will end at five, and we will have cleaned the square before the evening. To reassure every resident, and to allay any remaining fears, we also have a fallback plan in case of rain: the school hall. We are sure that this swap will bring neighbours together, and we would be very grateful if the council could approve it soon.
accepted: The objective of this proposal is to organise a winter clothes swap in the square on 14 November. The most tangible benefit is that families will save money and throw away fewer clothes. We recommend that the council approve the square for one afternoon, and we request a grant of 500 dollars for tables and posters. By 1 November we will have printed the posters, and within two weeks we will be advertising the swap in schools and shops. Admittedly, some residents may worry about noise and litter. That is a fair objection, but the swap will end at five, and we will have cleaned the square before the evening. To reassure every resident, and to allay any remaining fears, we also have a fallback plan in case of rain: the school hall. We are sure that this swap will bring neighbours together, and we would be very grateful if the council could approve it soon.

Our objective is to hold a clothes swap for winter in the main square. The benefit is clear: families will save money and everybody will throw away less. We suggest that the council approve the square for one afternoon, and we request a grant of 500 dollars. No later than 1 November we will have printed the posters, and within a month we will be advertising the event in every school and shop. I understand your concern about noise and litter. That is a fair point, so we propose that the swap finish at five, and we will have cleaned everything by six. To mitigate the risk of rain, our fallback plan is the school hall. We believe that the swap will be useful for families and will help to win over the neighbours who are still unsure, and we would like to start as soon as possible.

feedback.es: Una propuesta completa enlaza objetivo, beneficio, recomendación con that, fechas, petición y una respuesta concreta a la objeción.

origin.text: Escribe en inglés una propuesta de 150 a 260 palabras para un mercado de trueque de ropa de invierno en tu barrio (14 de noviembre, en la plaza). Incluye objetivo, un beneficio tangible, una recomendación con that, un hito con fecha y una petición. Después responde a esta objeción: «Habrá mucho ruido y nadie limpiará después».

prompt.es: Escucha el relato. ¿Qué muestra la forma de responder de la organizadora?

choices.text: That listening and offering concrete steps can win people over.
That angry neighbours should be asked to leave the meeting.
That the music will be cancelled if anyone complains.

feedback.es: La organizadora escucha, promete pasos concretos y consigue que dos vecinos enfadados acaben colaborando: eso es ganarse a quien dudaba.

origin.audio: At the residents' meeting, the organiser listened to every objection without interrupting. When a neighbour complained about the noise, she thanked him, promised that the music would stop at ten, and gave him her phone number in case of any problem. Two neighbours who had arrived angry left the meeting calmer, and one of them even volunteered to help clean the square.

prompt.es: ¿Por qué es una mala respuesta a la objeción esta réplica?

choices.text: It admits the risk but offers no plan.
It ignores the concern instead of giving a concrete guarantee.
It answers a different concern from the one raised.

feedback.es: La réplica descarta la preocupación («you are worrying too much») y no ofrece ninguna garantía concreta; no admite el riesgo ni cambia de tema.

origin.text: Objection: «Nobody will clean the square afterwards.» Reply: «You are worrying too much. Nothing like that has ever happened at our events, so please trust us and approve the proposal today.»

prompt.es: Completa: «Algunos miembros se opondrán a la fecha, así que prepara dos respuestas.»

feedback.es: Push back against algo es resistirse u oponerse con firmeza a una propuesta.

origin.text: We expect that some members will push ___ against the date, so we should prepare two answers in advance.
